verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no explicit SaaS region/residency selection feature (e.g., EU vs US data storage option), but it does document a fully supported self-hosted deployment model that lets users run Sentry on their own servers, giving them full control over where data resides. This indirectly satisfies data-residency needs but isn't the same as a native region-selection control. Missing for 10: explicit SaaS data-residency/region selection UI or docs, first-party statement on regional data storage options, independent confirmation of residency compliance.
